# Part VII: Text Analytics {.unnumbered}

Grievances, inspection notes, feedback forms and narrations hold information that numbers do not. This part shows how to turn free text into data: counting words and phrases, measuring sentiment, and drawing pictures of text, applied to the grievances and feedback of a health scheme.

The chapters in this part are:

- @sec-text, tokens, word frequencies and comparisons.
- @sec-sentiment, measuring the tone of feedback, and spotting feedback written by staff.
- @sec-textviz, word clouds and other pictures of text.
